$comment: Typechecks the tests and the tools as well as the source. Kept separate from tsconfig.json so that rollup, which reads that one, still sees only the files it bundles. `tools/` is here so that a test importing a tool gets real inferred types rather than `any` — without it, every value crossing that import defeats the type-aware lint rules silently. `checkJs` stays false: the tools are inferred from, not checked. See the `typecheck` script.
